summary.text: John E. Bartlett is the Democratic candidate for Indiana House of Representatives District 33 in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces incumbent Republican John Prescott.
An IT support team leader, he also ran for the seat in 2022 and 2024.

paragraphs.text: John E. Bartlett was born in Muncie, Indiana, and earned a bachelor's degree from Indiana University Bloomington in 1993.
His career experience includes working as an IT support team leader.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he lives on his grandparents' farm in Blackford County, has four grown children, and has worked in IT support for a major corporation in Indianapolis for more than 25 years.
Bartlett was the Democratic nominee for District 33 in 2022 and 2024, losing both times to Prescott, 70.4% to 29.6% in 2022 and 73.0% to 27.0% in 2024.
He advanced from the May 5, 2026 Democratic primary.
He listed rural broadband expansion, funding for education and trades instruction in high schools, and protecting family farms among his key messages.
